faqs.question: What does Ex-UK mean?
faqs.answer: Ex-UK means the mouse is used and was imported from the UK. It is not brand new, but it is a quality branded mouse at a lower price than a new one.

faqs.question: Which brand will I get?
faqs.answer: The brand depends on what we have in stock. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll tell you what's available, or send a photo of what you'd like.

faqs.question: Will it work with my laptop?
faqs.answer: It connects through a standard USB port, so it works with laptops and desktops that have a free USB port. If your laptop only has USB Type-C ports, you will need a USB-C adapter.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this mouse?
faqs.answer: This mouse comes with a warranty — message us on WhatsApp for the current term before ordering.
